training.corpus: simulated historical estate (data/generate_history.py) replayed through the production engine

abstention.reading: separation_auc is how well the top candidate's probability alone distinguishes an episode that has a driver from one that does not; 0.5 means it cannot, and the engine must keep abstaining on the evidence ladder alone

limitations: Trained on a SIMULATED historical estate, not on this company's resolved incidents. It demonstrates that the layer learns and can be evaluated; it is not evidence of accuracy on real episodes.
The ranker cannot exceed candidate-generation recall (0.8797 on the holdout) - a driver that was never proposed can never be ranked first.
Authority is advisory: reordering only. It cannot promote an evidence rung or change a verdict status.
Calibrated on 144 episodes; probabilities near the extremes rest on few observations.
